question:
Study the table showing patients treated (in thousands) in five hospital departments over three years and answer the question.

Department | 2021 | 2022 | 2023
Cardiology | 45 | 50 | 60
Neurology | 30 | 35 | 40
Orthopedics | 60 | 65 | 70
Pediatrics | 55 | 60 | 65
Emergency | 80 | 90 | 100

Q. Which department recorded the highest absolute growth in patient numbers from 2021 to 2023?
explanation: Absolute growth from 2021 to 2023 for each: Cardiology = 60 - 45 = 15; Neurology = 40 - 30 = 10; Orthopedics = 70 - 60 = 10; Pediatrics = 65 - 55 = 10; Emergency = 100 - 80 = 20. Emergency has the highest absolute growth of 20 thousand. Option A (Cardiology) is incorrect as its growth is 15.

Q. What is the ratio of the average female literacy rate to the average male literacy rate across the six states?

explanation_hi: महिला साक्षरता का योग = 432, औसत = 72। पुरुष साक्षरता का योग = 498, औसत = 83। औसत महिला और औसत पुरुष का अनुपात = 72 : 83। विकल्प B गलत है।
